book.name: 1 Abhakʉrintʉ
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ye embere ya Paaurʉ kwa Abhakʉrintʉ

content: Omosororo gwʉ ʉkʉsakirya abhiisirirya
Nangʉ nɨragamba igʉrʉ wo omosororo gwʉ ʉkʉsakirya abharɨndu bha Mungu bha mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu. Imwɨ mokore chɨmbu nabhabhuuriirɨ abhaatʉ bha amasengerero mucharʉ cha Garaatiya.

Urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtangɨ rwi inyuma, abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi gatɨ waanyu bhabhɨ bharatʉʉra ikibhumbɨkʉ kʉrɨngʼaana nʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhwabhʉ, korereke ribhaga rɨnʉ nikuuza kwa niimwɨ, mʉbhɨ mʉmarirɨ kukumɨnga omosororo.
Hanʉ nikuhika, nɨrabhatʉma na zɨnyarʉbha zu ubhwitʉndi abhaatʉ bhanʉ mokorobhora, korereke bhahirɨ omosororo guyo mwisengerero ga Yɨrusarɨɨmu.
Na arɨɨbhɨ ɨraarorekanɨ kʉbha inyɨ nereenderwa kuja, nɨraja hamwɨmwɨ nabhʉ.
Ubhwɨndi bhwa Paaurʉ kuhika Kʉrintʉ
Nɨraaza kwa niimwɨ iyo, hanʉ nikurwa mucharʉ cha Makɨdʉniya, kʉ kʉbha nereenda kʉhɨtɨra hinga Makɨdʉniya.
Hanʉ nikuuza, niriikara na niimwɨ ibhaga irebhe, hamwɨ kwibhaga ryʉsi rye embeho, korereke mʉnsakiryɨ kongʼeha no orogendo rwanɨ, hʉhʉʉsi hanʉ nikuja hanʉ nɨkʉmara ga hayo.
Nɨtakwenda kurumana na niimwɨ nangwɨnʉ kwa kʉhɨta. Niriisega kwikara kwa niimwɨ ibhaga irebhe, arɨɨbhɨ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ aranyiisiririryɨ.
Nawe nangʉ nɨrasaaga mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Efeeso hanʉ, kuhika urusikʉ rwi isigukuru ya Pɨntɨkʉsitɨ ihikɨ.
Nɨrakorabhu, kʉ kʉbha Mungu igwirɨ ɨnzɨra, korereke nekore emeremo mɨkʉrʉ mʉrʉbhɨri rʉnʉ, nangabha bhareho abhaatʉ bhaaru bhanʉ bhakʉnyanga.
Timoseo araaza kwa niimwɨ, mʉmʉsʉngʼaanɨ bhwaheene, korereke iikarɨ ataana ubhwʉbha, kʉ kʉbha ewe arakora emeremo jʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ ncha niinyɨ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi atamorega. Nawe mʉmʉsakiryɨ abhʉʉkɨ iyo no omorembe, korereke atʉrɨ kʉgarʉka ɨwaanɨ, kʉ kʉbha inyɨ nɨrarɨnda hamwɨmwɨ na abhiisirirya abhakɨndichɨtʉ.
Nangʉ, igʉrʉ wu umwisirirya ʉmʉkɨndichɨtʉ Apooro, nɨmʉkandikijiryɨ bhʉkʉngʼu aazɨ kwa niimwɨ hamwɨmwɨ na abhiisirirya abhandɨ. Nawe ewe atɨɨndirɨ kuuza nangwɨnʉ. Araaza hanʉ akobhona umweya.
Amangʼana gʉ ʉkʉraga
Mʉbhɨ mɨɨsʉ, mokongʼe mubhwisirirya, na mʉbhɨ abhakaari na bha amanaga.
Mʉbhɨ mʉrakora amangʼana gaanyu gʉʉsi kʉbhʉsɨɨgi.

Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, mwɨzɨ kʉbha Sitɨfaana hamwɨmwɨ na abhaatʉ bha yɨɨka waazɨ, nebho bhaarɨ bhe embere kwisirirya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ mucharʉ cha Akaaya, bhʉʉsi bhiihurukiryɨ kʉsakirya abharɨndu bha Mungu. Nɨrabhiisasaama,
mʉbhɨ muriigwa abhaatʉ ncha bhayo, na abhandɨ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakokora emeremo giyo hamwɨmwɨ nabhʉ kumucha.
Nɨrazomerwa bhʉkʉngʼu kʉbha Sitɨfaana, Fʉritunaatʉ na Akaikʉ, bhahikirɨ hanʉ. Ebho bhangʼɨɨrɨ ganʉ nasuuhiirwɨ kurwa kwa niimwɨ.
Bhɨɨriryɨ umwʉyʉ gwanɨ, na bhɨɨriryɨ zekoro zaanyu. Kʉgayo, mʉbhamenye bhwaheene abhaatʉ ncha bhanʉ.

Abhaatʉ bha amasengerero mucharʉ cha Asiya, bharabhakeerya. Akiira na mʉkaazɨ Pirisiira, hamwɨmwɨ na abhiisirirya bhanʉ bhahiibhiringa yɨɨka waabhʉ, bharabhakeerya bhʉkʉngʼu kuriina ryʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
Abhiisirirya bhʉʉsi bha hanʉ, bharabhakeerya. Mwikeerye kʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhwa Kiriisitʉ.
Inyɨ Paaurʉ nɨraandɨka amakeerenʼya ganʉ kokobhoko kwanɨ inyimwene.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ atasɨɨgirɨ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, ihiimwɨ. Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ uuzɨ!
Ɨbhɨgʉngi bhyʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu bhɨbhɨ na niimwɨ.
Nɨbhasɨɨgirɨ imwʉsi, ku kugwatana na Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
